evaluator.role: Factomaton evaluator/recorder, implementation author and original recipient assessment author

method.mode: One fresh sequential ordinary-content capture through the verified Factomaton bridge; no subscription/poll/ack consumer.
method.collector: Reviewed S3/S4 function bodies executed in isolated host JS Function scopes; only ESM export/import linkage adapted in memory, source files untouched. Not a built/runtime attestation.

manual_read.classification: Original recipient acceptance publication and limitations, not an observed withdrawal/correction to S8. Classification by its own author/evaluator is not independent review and is not machine-consumable full-content disposition.

findings.finding: A normal recipient assessment reply makes the current report pending even when all declared Git bindings match. The report has no versioned full-content disposition input; manual reading intentionally does not clear diagnostics.
findings.action: Specify exact post/revision/body-hash-bound disposition records with decision actor versus recorder and reviewer/author relationships; independently assess that scope before integration. Retain all authentication/freshness/runtime gates.

limits: One known completed same-owner review, prior author/reviewer exposure; no blind or general accuracy evaluation.
Verified session identity/ordinary tool use does not authenticate an exported capture against a hostile host.
Caller age bound300000ms observed, not production freshness policy or trusted-clock attestation.
One complete visible page/current reread does not establish hidden/unlinked/concurrent/later correction absence.
Manual own-reply classification is contextual and does not replace a separate review decision or automated disposition.
No raw connector responses or private inbox content published. Full raw capture/host log/report retained locally.
No code/schema/runtime/API/deployment/notification changes; consistency assertions only, no newly rerun regression-suite claim.
next_action: Define the smallest exact-version full-content disposition input addressing E1-F1, with separate decision actor/recorder and replay invalidation tests; keep all other unmet gates pending. Use a free Market scope after remote duplicate checks, no generic wrapper.
